scope: S3-E5 full registered 30-lineage roster; cached test predictions only
units: All metric values, CI limits and deltas are fractions; x100 gives percent or percentage points.

operational_definitions.head: exact top ceil(.2*N_catalog), training event count descending, original item ID ascending
operational_definitions.tail_primary: macro tail_hits/min(20,n_tail_truth) among users with tail truth
operational_definitions.tail_standard: macro tail_hits/n_tail_truth among users with tail truth
operational_definitions.tail_contribution: mean tail_hits/min(20,n_all_truth) among ALL evaluated users
operational_definitions.catalog_coverage: union of stored top20 item IDs / full original item catalog
operational_definitions.repaired: cos_prior for DirectAU; raw_prior for BPR; frozen validation-selected beta
operational_definitions.selection: No model scoring, ranking, training, clustering, or test-dependent selection

comparisons.direction: repaired GraphHash DirectAU minus same-dataset Full DirectAU raw
comparisons.decision_rule: mean delta < 0; CI is descriptive and does not change this rule
